feedback.problem: Given that $P(B)=0.7,$ $P(A\cap B)=0.3,$ and $P(A\cup B)=0.9,$ find $P({A}^{′}).$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we calculate $P(A)$ using the addition law:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B) \\ 0.9 & =P(A)+0.7-0.3 \\ P(A) & =0.9+0.3-0.7 \\ P(A) & =0.5\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P({A}^{′}) & =1-P(A) \\  & =1-0.5 \\  & =0.5.\end{aligned}
$$
